newsitem.title: FRANCE: Worms, St Louis plan merger.
newsitem.headline: Worms, St Louis plan merger.

text.p: French companies Worms & Cie and Saint Louis said in a joint statement on Friday they planned a full merger in which Saint Louis would be absorbed into Worms.
The merger was approved by both boards on Friday.
It will be based on four Worms shares for one Saint Louis share.

In future the dividend will be adjusted to ensure that Saint Louis shareholders receive an amount at least equivalent to that received up to now, the statement said. A proposal would be made to the next shareholders meeting to raise Worms' dividend to 9.50 francs per share from eight francs.
"After cancellation of Worms & Cie Treasury stock, the merger will not be dilutive for shareholders in terms of net asset value and earnings per share," the statement said.
